description: This file defines a Registry class for managing AT-SPI accessibility events, including methods for starting/stopping event loops, registering/deregistering event listeners, and generating synthetic input events. It appears to be part of a larger accessibility framework.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A singleton class wrapping the Accessibility.Registry to facilitate event registration, dispatch, and synthetic input generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Registry singleton, setting up internal state and main loop.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Registry.

methods.name: _set_registry
methods.description: Creates and sets a new registry with specified main loop type and application name.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Provides backward compatibility for 'async' attribute.

methods.name: __setattr__
methods.description: Provides backward compatibility for 'async' attribute.

methods.name: _set_default_registry
methods.description: Sets the default registry with GLib main loop.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the event loop, optionally releasing the GIL for other threads.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event loop.

methods.name: getDesktopCount
methods.description: Returns the number of available desktops (hardcoded to 1).

methods.name: getDesktop
methods.description: Returns a reference to the specified desktop.

methods.name: eventWrapper
methods.description: Wraps an event callback.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a client callback for specified event names.

methods.name: registerEventListenerWithApp
methods.description: Registers a client callback for specified event names with application context.

methods.name: deregisterEventListener
methods.description: Unregisters a client callback for specified event names.

methods.name: makeSyncType
methods.description: Creates a synchronization type flag for keystroke listeners.

methods.name: makeKind
methods.description: Creates a bitmask representing event kinds.

methods.name: registerKeystrokeListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for keystroke events.

methods.name: deregisterKeystrokeListener
methods.description: Deregisters a keystroke listener.

methods.name: generateKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Synthesizes a keyboard event.

methods.name: generateMouseEvent
methods.description: Synthesizes a mouse event at specified coordinates.

methods.name: setReferenceWIndow
methods.description: Sets the reference window for mouse events, due to coordinate limitations.

methods.name: pumpQueuedEvents
methods.description: Dispatches queued events (stub implementation).
